reviews.title: I will avoid in future
reviews.text: Very late. Very dirty - or rather, they just didn't clean the plane. No apologies. Reached Gatwick airport with limited methods of getting home. I will avoid their service in future. And every time I see their adverts, I'm reminded of how awful my experience was and then looking at reviews from other people, I realised it was my fault for not checking reviews first.
reviews.author: GemmaBlackUK

reviews.title: Surely Vueling Could Do Better
reviews.text: This particular flight was not one of V's bargains, and so it was especially annoying when (1) the flight attendants were so cold they could have frozen standing water, (2) they positioned their drink carts in such a way that they blocked access to both front and rear WCs for nearly 40 minutes and were miffed when people needed to get to a bathroom while they were serving from their carts at glacial pace, (3 their weird new way of unloading the plane 5 rows at a time made it difficult for some people in the back half to make their next flights. Oh, and did I mentioned how conned the people on my row felt when the More Space seats they had paid for had no More Space that any other seat on the plane. Or that it's impossible to reach anyone at Vueling by any click-option offered on their website.
reviews.author: Fred193

reviews.title: Couldn't have asked for more
reviews.text: After reading reviews over the last month, I was not looking forward to using Vueling. I expected the worst and got the opposite. Checked in online with printed passes, all good. Made sure luggage was within limited, so all was well there. Only took what we were allowed as cabin bags (underneath bag). Flight was on time, left on time, and arrived on time. Even disembarking was done in an orderly fashion. Staff are all really friendly and helpful. It is a budget airline, so don't expect first-class treatment. Would not hesitate to use it again.
reviews.author: Christine L
reviews.route: London - Las Palmas de Gran Canaria

reviews.title: A very basic flying experience - fine as long as everything's going okay
reviews.text: I'd never heard of Vueling before booking as part of a package deal - they had the best prices for flight times that suited. The online check-in process was quite easy however the booking management page was a bit confusing - it was never fully clear whether the ATPs for travel to Spain were completed correctly as the passport details section always indicated it was 'not filled in', depsite the information being recorded there and the site allowing the printing of boarding passes. I spent an entire morning trying to get through to Vueling's customer service to query the matter but never got anywhere with it (I just ended up in an automated loop of doom). In the end I took a chance on it probably being okay and it turns out it was. The airport experience travelling from Gatwick to BCN was no hassle; self check-in worked a dream and the flight was on time. On board was very basic, probably even more so than Easyjet, but that doesn't matter for a couple of hours. The return journey from Barcelona was more complicated. Self check-in machines wouldn't work for hold luggage but this wasn't flagged up before starting so time was spent queueing up unnecessarilly at the machines. There was no information available about what to do instead so we had to find someone working for Iberia who could help with working out which desk we were meant to go to check in the 'old fashioned way'. Then, by the time the gate number was announced there was relatively little time to get through passport
reviews.author: Fabs_C

reviews.title: great value
reviews.text: Was slightly worried about flying with Vueling after reading some of the negative reviews but the truth is we had a great flight Flying from Gatwick to Rome on a tuesday morning check in / bag drop was quick and easy. Plane was clean, staff were friendly and although space in economy seats is always tight at 5.11 tall i wasnt cramped at all. Bags came through at Rome airport within a short time no problems at all. flying back was much the same experience apart from check in took a little longer in Rome but only a few minutes
reviews.author: shaun freestone

reviews.title: total ignorance and customer despisal
reviews.text: i have three return tickets on hand purchased three years ago. vueling canceled those flights and issued vouchers to refund after three years. now i has tried to request the refund, but they just keep ignoring my requests.
reviews.author: alexander

reviews.title: Horrible start to the holiday.
reviews.text: Horrible start to the holiday! We are a family of 4; 2 adults,2children. The night before our flight we checked in online. The site wanted us to prebook our seats for almost £50 each so we left that part. On arrival at Gatwick -they put all our luggage through and all was fine. I said to the staff member, ‘Are we sitting together?’ The response was, ‘You will find out at the gate when you board.’ We thought this was strange but didn’t think much of it. At the gate and about to board, one of the staff said to us if we could wait at the side…. we queried why, but he said to give him a minute. Later on he came over and calmly as you like, said are you ok to ‘split fly 3/1?’ We assumed he meant 3 seated together and one separately so said fine. 5 minutes later he said he wanted to confirm that we were ok with 3 of us flying now and one at a different time!!!! What?!?!? It took me some time to process what the hell was going on. Of course we complained and said we booked this flight 6 months ago and you have checked us in as a family but all the staff looked incredulous. Apparently this goes on ALL the time - even if we had prebooked seats, another member of staff said Vueling change the size of the plane last minute. Last week 40 people didn’t get on!!! It was an absolute headache and all we got was here’s an email address to complain to. Staff are unsympathetic, I think because this is what the airline does so frequently it has become the norm for them. Luckily someone cancelled
reviews.author: APL563

reviews.title: Terrible! Can’t describe these people’s incompetence in other words
reviews.text: Lost a baggage in a direct flight. Definitely won’t be flying with this airline again. Gets you wondering how is it possible for them to lose so much luggage- someone is apparently not doing their job right.
reviews.author: Μπέττυ Λ

reviews.title: Hard case luggage surcharge - disabled discrimination
reviews.text: Travelled with small hard shell suitcase that fitted under seat from London to Asturias with no problem. Travelling back, at boarding gate they surcharged me £60 at Asturias stating that charge was for hard case, objected that as it was not a soft backpack and would not squash to fit. Actual suitcase was 40×30×20 but I did not include wheels. Picture with size 6 flipflop for comparison. I am disabled, carrying luggage in a backpack is difficult and this is discrimination. Several other passengers were also surcharged. Forced to pay or would have removed suitcase which had my medication in it. Beware.
reviews.author: Pamela M

reviews.title: Pretty smooth
reviews.text: I was a bit skeptical at first because I didn't knew much about this airline. I flew from Milano Malpensa (MXP) to (BCN) in Barcelona and it went pretty smoothly. The aircraft that I flew with was an A320 and it was quiet smaller compare to I usually go with, but considering the distance, it was more than enough. The seats were standard and the leg room space was ok. There was obviously no mini monitors on them and the only thing that they could provide were snacks and wifi which you need to pay for both (optional). I was a bit dissappointed that the Wifi needed to be rented for a fee. Overall it is cheap and could get you to your destination and I highly reccomend it for families.
reviews.author: John Charles Marasigan

reviews.title: Please please read the reviews
reviews.text: This company represents a new low for customer service. There are literally no live agents. You will spend hours going around in circles, pushing buttons and getting nowhere. They moved my flight to another day and there is nothing I can do about it as I missed the change of day, and only clocked the time change. So they will happily keep all the money including baggage and taxes etc.
reviews.author: Disco

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: It's a nightmare. If you want to be stressed out to the maximum with rules that make no sense and are not properly disclosed with zero customer service and then forced to comply and pay additional charges only to arrive late then this is the airline for you. Let's start with normal which is arrive about an 90 minutes before you flight leaves. Now if your flight is delayed three hours what time should you arrive. Well this airline will cancel your ticket if you don't arrive an hour before the originally scheduled flight not withstanding that plane isn't going anywhere for hours. Worse if you have a completely changeable ticket and you arrive 30 minutes before original scheduled depart and four hours before actual departs your ticket becomes non cancelable and non changeable without payment of the full change fee. Which will likely exceed the cost of buying a new flight. So after you pay for the next flight then you loose your seat selection and your carry on bags. I got a notice the next flight was delayed over an hour but they want you to board on time to just sit on the airplane. Essentially I lost one full day of my trip and my life. It took me about nine hours to take a one hour flight plus almost double what I initially paid. Don't fall for the cheap price. They will get you with hidden charges and rules. This was my second time flying this airline. The first time was even worse.
reviews.author: zachary z

reviews.title: Scam artists
reviews.text: Do not book this airline…. They don’t have ANYONE in customer service. I don’t think they even have a customer service department…. They don’t give refunds or care that you got screwed…
reviews.author: Davidoff1982

reviews.title: TERRIBLE OVERBOOKING BY 48 PEOPLE
reviews.text: I would not recommend this company they are absolutely cowboys when it comes to their competition, managed to ruin my best friends STAG do due to overbooking the plane by 48 passengers. So it meant that only 6 out of the group managed to get on the plane when I booked / made the arrangements over 4 months ago. There solution was to offer a flight at 8pm that night to Paris and then stop over for 7 hours to then get a flight which wasn't and isn't acceptable at all! Like I said do not use this company unless you like stress, disappointment and a general feeling of sadness
reviews.author: Nathan P

reviews.title: Ansolute worst. Criminal.
reviews.text: They will cancel your flights. They will lose your luggage. And they will do nothing about it. Be prepared to make repeated calls, be answered by robots, and when you finally get through to a human being, that human being will be nonchalant, and hang up on you. Never ever fly with them.
reviews.author: Samuel P

reviews.title: Avoid this airline
reviews.text: Shocking service. Avoid this airline. Two weeks in a row I booked the 14:10 flight 19th and 26th June 2023) Both times the airline changed it to 19:15. I checked in online both times. Each time boarding was delayed. Then, both times, every person that had checked in online was not actually checked-in in the system. This meant that boarding gate staff had to manually re-check in every such person and issue them a paper ticket. Both flights eventually arrived in Barcelona after midnight compared to 17:25 per the original booking. Reason for delay; technical issues. You can say that again, but not to me. I won’t be there.
reviews.author: Malcolm B

reviews.title: THE WORST TRAVEL EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: do NOT fly Vueling. The absolute, worst customer service. The phone lines, if you can actually get through to talking to an agent because it is a robot, keeps directing you to go online, but it is just a robot chat service. I once was hung up on by a customer service agent, when I was in the airport due to a delay, the agent didn't even see, or know that there was a delay. It is a completely inadequate airline. They lost my check in bag and have not helped me at all find its location. I am now in a battle to be refunded and compensated for missing my other connecting flights to the US because of their error.
reviews.author: samarashoo

reviews.title: Worst airline ever flown with
reviews.text: This is without a doubt the worst airline I’ve ever flown with. I had a morning flight from Gatwick to Barcelona when at the boarding gate I showed them my ticket and they said to each other she doesn’t have a seat to which I was like not sure what you mean there is a seat number on my ticket they then just asked me to wait at the side. A few more passengers tried to board also asked to wait to the side then heard them say because of emergency exits on the plane not working we would not be able to board the plane. Approximately 60 passengers not allowed to Board. There was zero communication between staff and passengers for over an hour and when they was asked what was happening for any sort of clarity they would say sorry we don’t know right now just bare with us. Then they said there was other flights that day one at 1300 one at 1530 1740 and 2100 but the only flight we could get on was 2100. This was a significant delay from the 0900 flight that morning. There was no food vouchers or any compensations that day. When asked could they get another plane or put us on another flight which they aid we don’t do that. As the 2100 flight would get me too late into Barcelona and as a women travelling on her own getting on public transport at close to 0100 wouldn’t be an option so had to book a flight for next morning where I lost a whole day of my holiday
reviews.author: Clare H

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Flight time changed over 6 times and the final time they decided on was too early/optimistic. They had everyone stand and wait in line for an hour before boarding. No updates on when we will board. No one to talk to because no one is at the counter. No one knows what to do or what’s happening. Hope the pilot is better than the service. At this point the passengers have stood in line longer than they would have seated on the plane flight.
reviews.author: Brian L

reviews.title: Worst Airlines -Bad costumer service
reviews.text: Worst experience I ever had with costumer services. My flight from Barcelona to LCA on the 19th of June got cancelled and Vueling provided me with the option of either get a refund or change the flight. As ALL the flights from Barcelona to Larnaca were cancelled in June I left with no option but proceed with refund. I got the email that it will take up to 7 working days to get the refund. Later on I got an email saying that I got flight credit which means that Vueling is keeping the money and I can use them for a different flight something that I did NOT asked. IT IS IMPOSSIBLE TO CONTACT THEM, I contacted the BCN airport they couldn't help ,I used the online chat on their website which both times all of a sudden I had "poor connection" when I asked for the refund. We only exchanged few emails telling me the same thing again and again in regards to flight credit. TERRIBLE
reviews.author: NIKOLETTA M

reviews.title: Atrocious Customer Service - Avoid this Airline
reviews.text: By far the worst customer service I've ever experienced. An infinite loop between a useless "virtual assistaint", website and the phone service. Hours waiting and stuck on a loop with the phone robots, always missing the option to talk to someone about the actual problem you have. They offer only the options that you could sue them for if they hadn't. Again, atrocious. If you have any issues with your booking expect to be charged even for looking at it.
reviews.author: Albert C

reviews.title: The worst airline company
reviews.text: The worst airline company ever. I will proceed with legal actions against it. I was trying to do online check in the day before and they didn’t allow me. Arriving to the airport 2.5 hours before the flight. The screen was showing wrong numbers for the desk to check in. I was waiting 45 minutes in a wrong desk. Then I had to go to another desk waiting for another 30 minutes to check in. Being in the desk 1 hour and 1 minute before the flight. And the girl there told me to go to the another desk which is last minute. Then I went there waiting 3-4 minutes. Then the girl there told me that the flight was closed because I am late one minute. The check in is closed one hour before the flight apperantly 🤷‍♂️. Then she told me to go and buy another ticket for the next flight. Paying 2 times more agin of the actual ticket, costs me 125 euros extra. They use such manipulating tactics. I will do everything in my power to close this airline company.
reviews.author: Marios G

reviews.title: Website forced you to pay for 2 cabin bag if you are 2 pp even if you only have 1 luggage to add
reviews.text: There website won't allow to pay for 1 extra cabin luggage if you are 2 persons. But you are force to pay for 2 extra luggage. If you dont pay for 2 luggage even if you have 1 , they charged me 50€ for 1 luggage. Seriously Rip off website system, I would not have complained if they made it clear that wether you adding one or 2 luggage it's minimum 50€.
reviews.author: THE C

reviews.title: Delayed and then told the flight was overbooked
reviews.text: I got to the airport more than 2 hours ahead of the scheduled departure time and was told the flight was overbooked despite checking in. When boarding was annouced, I wasn't allocated a seat. Though I was a single woman travelling alone, I was told I would be compensated and was assigned a flight that was taking off 12 hours later on the next afternoon. I was made to wait more than 2 hours after the flight's departure before they assigned a hotel for me to stay the night. Extremely poor management. I'm astonished that they can still overbook a flight in this day and age. I won't be flying Vueling again. Ever.
reviews.author: Eunice D

reviews.title: What a joke
reviews.text: No gate number till last minute Loading passengers they had no idea On a 6 week holiday No bags turned up at Venice. 7 days later still No bags, contacted vueling No interest whatsoever The couldn't care less, the staff hung up on our calls many times, we have sent emails and too many calls still No response.ANOTHER 5 WEEKS TO GO WITH NO LLUGGAGE VUELING ARE A DISGRACE AND HAVE NO CARE, PLEASE STEER CLEAR.
reviews.author: Paul

reviews.title: Fine low price carrier
reviews.text: Fine trip where you get your money worth. Service minded staff and good boarding procedure, though some passengers were quite undisciplined and rude when disembarking.
reviews.author: LarsBA

reviews.title: Worst Airline Ever
reviews.text: Hard to believe one company could have so many rude, arrogant, ignorant and lazy employees. Rating this airline a one is overly generous Don't make the mistake of booking a flight with this worthless airline. If you do, you will regret it!
reviews.author: Donn M

reviews.title: Worsted Airlines I have ever seen in my life
reviews.text: I had purchased ticket through there website and had done the check in also, while reached to the airport with boarding pass, they didn't allow me to board, they said booking cancelled, again next day booked & reached but same, they not allow me to board,showing booking cancelled, without any prior notice. so don't book vueling airlines.
reviews.author: Sakib U

reviews.title: Absolutely NOT possible to get in touch with Vueling!!!!
reviews.text: They charged me for seat reservation AND € 1 extra for my luggage at the check out (2x € 38 = €79 ???) BUT I was not allowed to seat in my seat and had to change it because I was travelling with my dog which they knew from the beginning! Now I seem to have received an email which I never did and it is simply impossible for me to get in touch with Vueling. Even I send them a few new messages through the robot they simply do not respons. This new way of working & mindset, this way of inhumanly approach to people is just lowest of the low!
reviews.author: Sheida70

reviews.title: First and.....last!
reviews.text: Awful!. Booked via 3rd party website. Problems with tickets at check in - would not accept although clearly visible on their computer that they had Overbooked, which seems a regular occurrence. Problems on board with seat allocation and customer demanding his seat when already occupied. Eventually I think someone was paid off to vacate their seat and leave, meaning flight delayed and slot missed. Flight attendants had no idea what was going on, airport security on board, seats counted 4 times and still no idea.. Standby passengers then boarded! Overloaded with screaming kids! Very little food on offer, only Becks beer, no tea, no crisps, close to zero. All in all I suppose you get what you pay for and this was a cheap flight. I should have read reviews prior to booking. As the song goes "...things can only get better" - but I won't hold my breath
reviews.author: TonyP1
